why: The student doesn't trace the given %6.2f call. Instead they correctly predict what a precision change to %.3f would print (3.142, no padding) and say what stays the same: the stored value of price is unchanged and only the printed digits differ.

concepts.quote: With %.3f it would print 3.142 and no spaces. price itself is still 3.14159; only the printed digits change.
concepts.why: The answer correctly reasons that changing the precision changes only the printed digits, not the stored value, and that dropping the width removes the padding.
